notes: Line numbers are the ARRAY LOAD / DIVISION site as reported by the engine.

Most findings land on the private helper (use / indexNowhere / divideNowhere) rather than on the caller that holds the range fact. That is the headline result: the range domain is computed per-method and is not carried in interprocedural summaries.
Line 68 in L3 and line 23 in L4 are the private helpers; the caller-specific cases are scored separately below.

cases.note: safeAfterGuard: index guarded to [0,2] against a length-3 array. Must stay silent.
unsafeWithoutGuard: same array, no guard. Must fire.
safeAfterDivisorCheck: b == 0 guarded before division. Must stay silent.
safeViaClamp: Math.max/min clamp into [0,2]. This is the key intra-procedural probe: a real range domain should silence it.
unsafeClampShadowed: a clamp exists but the RAW index is used. Must fire.
safeCallerIndex: caller clamps, callee indexes. Must stay silent IF the range is propagated in the summary.

unsafeCallerIndex: raw index passed to the callee. Must fire. [R1101: re-pinned to the callee operation site. The boundary checkers report where the index/division happens, which is inside the callee; the caller line was never going to carry this finding.]
safeTwoHopsAway: guard in a helper, use two frames away.

unsafeTwoHopsAway: guard disabled via limit<0, use two frames away. [R1101: re-pinned to the callee operation site. The boundary checkers report where the index/division happens, which is inside the callee; the caller line was never going to carry this finding.]

unsafeDivisorAcrossBoundary: no guard, division in the callee. [R1101: re-pinned to the callee operation site. The boundary checkers report where the index/division happens, which is inside the callee; the caller line was never going to carry this finding.]
unsafeThroughBoxing: the Integer box carries the RAW index while a different variable is clamped. Must fire.
safeThroughField: clamped into a Holder field, read back, used.
safeThroughCollection: clamp survives a List round-trip.
safeEarlyReturn: every path reaching the access passed the bounds check.
safeOneBranchReturns: the join is unreachable on the returning path.
safeSwitchAllCases: every reachable case narrows, default throws.
